target_customer: Small and mid size companies running databases in AWS
problem: Databases get accidentally exposed to the public internet in cloud accounts and attackers find them first.

founders.name: Rob Picard
founders.background_notes: Penetration tester then application security and incident response, per Failory interview (age 28 stated there). Later Security Lead at Vanta.

exit.reason: Founder stopped after about ten months, returned remaining money ($370,545.77) to investors; no burning need, trial users would not pay.

competitors.name: Wiz
competitors.what: Agentless cloud security platform scanning for misconfigurations and exposure
competitors.funding_then: $100M at stealth exit Dec 2020, then $130M March 2021

competitors.name: Orca Security
competitors.what: Agentless cloud security including exposed data detection

technical_complexity.rationale: Watching new public IPs in AWS accounts and scanning them is straightforward API work.

defensibility.rationale: AWS native tools and well funded platforms could replicate the feature; no data or network effect.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded cloud security platforms bundled exposure detection; Observa shut down in September 2021.

market_need_then: Accidental database exposure was a known risk, but trial users in the founder's account did not see it as a burning need and would not pay.

branding.domain_note: observa.com (exact .com), though the host did not resolve from the research environment.

brand_strength.rationale: One person company with a Product Hunt launch on 2021-05-27; confusable with other Observa and Observer products.

pivots.from: Lightweight intrusion detection system and tool to share credential stuffing attacker IPs
pivots.to: Accidental database exposure detection for AWS
pivots.why: Earlier ideas did not find a burning need, per Failory interview

outcome_analysis: Observa was a solo founder project that tried several security ideas and settled on detecting accidental database exposure in AWS. Trial users were not interested in the findings and would not pay, so after about ten months and no revenue the founder returned remaining money to investors in September 2021. He then moved to Vanta. The failure was a lack of market need and willingness to pay, with well funded cloud security platforms nearby.
notes: The $462,000 raised is from the founder's Failory interview; investors not named (Pioneer Fund affiliation on YC page is unconfirmed as an investor). Education not found. Founder stopped in Sept 2021, ten months after start. observa.com did not resolve in the fetch tool, so the site is treated as dead or blocked. A CB Insights record showing 2.29M raised and founded 2015 appears to describe a different company. Name origin not found.
